stories.title: Patient-derived organoids reveal strain-specific efficacy of engineered bacteria in colorectal cancer
stories.takeaway: Patient-derived colorectal tumor organoids show differing colonization and responses to engineered Salmonella versus probiotic E. coli.
stories.what_happened: Patient-derived colorectal tumor organoids show differing colonization and responses to engineered Salmonella versus probiotic E. coli.
stories.why_it_matters: Human-derived organoids provide a platform to compare microbial therapeutics before clinical testing.
stories.caveat: Organoid results do not establish in-vivo safety or clinical efficacy.

stories.title: Gut microbiota GABA regulation by intestinal pH osmolality and microbial consumption
stories.takeaway: Gut microbial GABA availability depends on physicochemical conditions and microbial production and consumption.
stories.what_happened: Gut microbial GABA availability depends on physicochemical conditions and microbial production and consumption.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows why environmental controls matter when interpreting microbial metabolites.
stories.caveat: In-vitro ecological regulation may differ from in-vivo host exposure.

stories.title: Macrophage Slfn4 attenuates colonic inflammation and tumorigenesis through Rac1-dependent phagocytosis and oxidative burst
stories.takeaway: Slfn4 supports macrophage antibacterial activity and limits experimental colitis and colitis-associated cancer.
stories.what_happened: Slfn4 supports macrophage antibacterial activity and limits experimental colitis and colitis-associated cancer.
stories.why_it_matters: Links immune bacterial clearance with intestinal inflammatory outcomes.
stories.caveat: Mouse and cell findings are not validated therapeutic targets in humans.

stories.title: Designer mucin-responsive nanomedicine for enhanced solid tumour penetration and therapy
stories.takeaway: Mucin-triggered micelle disassembly improves delivery into experimental pancreatic tumors.
stories.what_happened: Mucin-triggered micelle disassembly improves delivery into experimental pancreatic tumors.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights mucin as a transport barrier and stimulus for drug delivery design.
stories.caveat: Mouse tumor results do not prove clinical efficacy or gastrointestinal delivery.

stories.title: Epigenetics in inflammatory bowel disease: from mechanistic insights to personalized therapeutic strategies
stories.takeaway: Reviews methylation signatures, exposures and potential IBD treatment-response stratification.
stories.what_happened: Reviews methylation signatures, exposures and potential IBD treatment-response stratification.
stories.why_it_matters: Separates systemic biomarkers from tissue-resolved disease biology.
